metadata.source: Gmail refresh on 2026-05-16 using broad transactional searches plus supplier coverage examples. Added Amazon Cuperinox, Aottori, L'OR Ristretto, and 18-piece silicone-lid kit open deliveries from May 15 order/dispatch mail; updated the JOMIX clogs estimate to 21-22 May; removed AliExpress package 291300000090583640 after delivery confirmation on 15 May; removed the Kssiaz 15 April Amazon return-window row because its assumed return deadline expired with no return request found. Kept MAGEFESA as the only urgent authorized return because no newer drop-off/refund completion was found. Found no newer concrete license or subscription renewal/cancellation state. Excluded marketing, newsletters, review prompts, login/security mail, delivery-status bounces, supplier promotions, generic project posts, and completed drop-off/refund returns.
